productName: French Country 4 Drawer Dresser with Changing Table
description:
Get the best of both worlds with the French Country 4 Drawer Dresser with Changing Table. This complete nursery solution pairs a spacious four-drawer dresser with a dedicated changing station, giving you everything you need for daily diaper changes and clothing storage in one beautiful piece.

The attached changing table sits at the perfect height for comfortable diaper changes, with safety rails to keep your baby secure. Below, four dovetailed drawers with smooth glides provide generous storage for clothing, blankets, and nursery supplies. Crafted from solid wood with the signature French Country detailing, this piece becomes the functional heart of your nursery.

The warm finishes and rustic charm coordinate with the full French Country collection for a beautifully cohesive nursery.
